item.title: S'porean suspected member of Cambodian scam syndicate arrested while hiding in Thai wife's house
item.description: A Singaporean suspected member of a Cambodia-based scam syndicate was arrested while hiding in his Thai wife's house.

item.title: Universal Traveller Mega Expo Sale has up to 80% off winter wear, win a trip to Italy or Korea
item.description: From 21 to 23 Nov 2025, the Universal Traveller Winter Wear & Luggage Mega Expo Sale returns with the best deals on winter essentials.

item.title: Semeru volcano erupts near Bali, triggers Indonesia's highest alert & evacuation of over 1,000 residents
item.description: Indonesia's Mount Semeru, 310km from Bali, erupted on 19 Nov, as the alert status is raised to its highest level.

item.title: Woman fined S$21.5K for keeping 79 unlicensed dogs in S'pore home & failing to comply with authorities
item.description: A 50-year-old Singaporean woman received a fine of S21,500 after keeping 79 unlicensed dogs in her landed home.

item.title: Netizens upset as SCDF Electric Pump Ladder toy souvenir unavailable due to 'unforeseen shipping delays'
item.description: Fans were left disappointed after SCDF announced that the Electric Pump Ladder toy would be unavailable due to “unforeseen shipping delays.”

item.title: Woman driving Mercedes-Benz spotted defecating on the roadside in Taiwan
item.description: A woman was caught on CCTV defecating on the roadside in Miaoli, Taiwan on 17 Nov, drawing criticism from netizens.

item.title: Taxi sideswipes motorcycle on AYE, sends sparks flying & knocks rider over
item.description: A rider was knocked over on the AYE after a ComfortDelGro taxi sideswiped his motorcycle. He was conveyed to NUH after the incident.

item.title: S’porean man asks if NS changes one's mindset, some netizens say it changed them 'for the better'
item.description: A recent post on r/askSingapore sparked debate after a S'porean reflected on how his two-year NS stint left a lasting impact on his mindset.

item.title: UK school bans 'KPop Demon Hunters' songs over concerns they make some Christians 'deeply uncomfortable'
item.description: A school in the UK bans kids from singing KPop Demon Hunters because it made references to things that made Christians uncomfortable.

item.title: Man allegedly set Bukit Batok community cats' houses on fire, repeatedly threw cardboard shelters away for months
item.description: A 67-year-old man was arrested for allegedly setting fire to community cats' houses placed in HDB void decks in Bukit Batok.
